I wrote the LRU cache in `main.wj`. It compiles and gives the expected output for Example 1. I didn't run Example 2 or any other inputs.

The cache is two parallel lists, one for keys and one for values. The most recently used entry sits at index 0, and the last entry is the one evicted. Capacity is at most 50, so the linear scans are cheap.
